rows.en: (Oh, there's Luca-kun.)
So, what should we start with today?
...Luca-kun... Do you want to be all macho?
(A macho Luca-kun, huh...)

You're stronger than you look.
Bench-pressing 40 kg...

I can't let you beat me either!
All right, Luca-kun, 50 kg!
No problem!
Ouch, ouch...
rows.notes: Female (itata; male c08890 atata is 'Ow, ow...').

rows.en:
I'm not patching you up.
You can do it yourself.
rows.notes: Female version of c08892 (he won't ask her to undress).

rows.en: I'm sorry...
You're right...
rows.notes: Female; answers Luca's 'getting hurt while training is silly'.

rows.en: Okaaay...

But you've really got your head on straight,
Luca-kun.
Yeah, let's!
rows.notes: x5, all female player: answers 'let's do our best together' (Luca), 'shall we go change' / 'shall we head home' (Miyuki), 'let's go see a movie' (Ranka), 'let's hurry to the party' (Akimizu). Every context is a 'let's' proposal.

rows.en: I'm totally beat~
Okaaay, got it.
rows.notes: x2: Luca's 'cool down properly' and Sheryl's 'keep this secret from Grace' (nml_she_008). Both female.

rows.en: Yeah, see you next time.

(Now I'd better head home and give myself
a massage...)

(Training with Luca again today.
Time to get fired up and give it my all!)

You're really fired up,
\p-san.
rows.notes: x2, Luca to male and female player.

rows.en: Of course!
rows.notes: x3: also female in frd_myk_112 and frd_rnk_008.

rows.en: Be careful not to get hurt.
Man, I'm tired.
Good work.
rows.notes: x6, Luca, frd_luk_002/005 both genders, after training or flight practice. Kept distinct from c08900 'Good work today.' (kyou wa otsukaresama deshita).

rows.en: (That was a really solid workout!)

(Training with Luca-kun again today.
Time to get fired up and give it my all!)
Of course I am!
Mmm, that was tiring~
(That was a really solid workout!)
(Well, that's it for today's classes, but...)
...I'm bored, Luca.
rows.notes: Male. Hima = nothing to do; subject restored as the player.

rows.en: I'm not, really.
rows.notes: x4, Luca, both genders: answers 'I'm bored, Luca' and, in the second scene, the player's unspoken '(I'm so bored~)'.

rows.en:
You're no fun.
Got any interesting stories?

I don't have any stories like that.
Why don't you go home and study or something?

I've been studying at school all day, you know?
You're so serious, Luca...

That's not true.
We're students in the first place,
so isn't it only natural?
No, see, that's exactly what I mean...
Ah! Haha...
rows.notes: Male; Luca's sheepish laugh (or he spots Nanase); kept neutral.

rows.en: Hm? Who's that over there...
Oh, Nanase-san.

Nanase's gone.
Off to her club, maybe?

Huh? What's up, Luca?
Got some business with Nanase?

N-nothing's up with me!
What are you even saying, geez!
(He's so easy to read...)
What's with that look?

Nanase's cute, after all.
I get how you feel.
I don't need you to get it, thank you!
rows.notes: x2, Luca; polite but sharp rebuff (wakatte itadakanakute kekkou desu).

rows.en: So it's that, huh? You like that about her?
rows.notes: Male; deliberately vague 'are' (that), a sly hint left as vague as the Japanese.

rows.en: What do you mean, 'that'?!
Heh heh...
Geez, I'm going home!

Hey, wait up.
Let's stop somewhere on the way.

I have to go to Deep Akihabara,
so you can go on your own!
rows.notes: x2, Luca. Deep Akihabara from locations.json.

rows.en: Oh boy...
rows.notes: x2: also male player in frd_rnk_007 when Ranka rushes in to help at Nyan-Nyan.

rows.en: (Maybe I teased him a little too much?)
(Well, that's it for today's classes, but...)
I'm bored, Luca-kun.

You're no fun.
Don't you have anything interesting to talk about?

I've been studying all day, you know?
Of course I want a little break...

What?!
Don't look at me like that!

Nanase's gone.
Off to her club, maybe?

Ooh? What's up with you, Luca-kun?
You were totally staring at her.

I-I wasn't staring at her or anything!
What are you even saying, geez!
(He's so easy to read...)

Nanase's cute, after all.
I get how you feel, yep.

Hey, wait up.
Wanna stop somewhere on the way home?
You're no fun...
(School's out, but I'm so bored~)

Huh, how did you know?
I didn't say it out loud.

It was written all over
your face, \p-san.
(Am I that easy to read?)
You're very easy to read.
rows.notes: x2, Luca, both genders (he answers the unspoken thought again).

rows.en: Wanna head home?
(I had a fun time with Luca after school.)
(School's out, but I'm so bored~)

Huh, how did you know?
I didn't say it out loud...
(...Am I that easy to read?)
(I had a fun time with Luca-kun after school.)

uncertain: c08921: 'Yeah, let's!' chosen because all five uses (Luca, Miyuki, Ranka, Akimizu scenes) answer a 'let's' proposal.
c08955: the player's vague 'that' (are) about Nanase left vague in English.
c08945: Luca's 'Ah! Haha...' could be a sheepish laugh or him spotting Nanase; kept neutral.
